summary: ZipRecruiter filed an 8-K announcing the appointment of Carmen Chan as Chief Financial Officer, effective August 17, 2026. The filing details her compensation package: $500,000 base salary, minimum 2026 bonus of $100,000, a $200,000 onboarding bonus, up to $100,000 in relocation reimbursements, and 650,000 RSUs (500,000 time-vested, 150,000 performance-based). This is a routine executive appointment and compensatory arrangement, not a special-situation event. No strategic or transactional elements are present, and the departure was not characterized as forced. The filing is a standard 8-K with no implications for shareholders beyond routine personnel changes.
